verdict.rationale: Docs claim native tracking from tools like Slack/Figma/Gmail and 3000+ Marketplace integrations covering GitHub, Slack, Google Drive, etc., but the evidence pack lacks explicit first-party confirmation of GitHub or Google Drive specifically and relies on generic marketplace claims rather than documented native connectors. Missing for 10: explicit named GitHub/Google Drive integration docs, hands-on/independent confirmation these integrations work smoothly, and detail on setup/native vs marketplace-app distinction.
